title: Make Masks
description: Correct ER-derived cell labels interactively and create new training masks from real microscopy fields.
objectives: Open microscopy images with optional matching label masks.
Use brush, erase, object, magic-wand, zoom, history, and cleanup tools.
Save curated uint16 TIFF labels for Cellpose training.
prerequisite: Prepare a folder of two-dimensional microscopy images. Put matching label images in a masks subfolder when existing segmentations are available.

scenes.narration: Make Masks is spaCR's interactive editor for correcting segmentation labels and creating Cellpose training pairs. Open a folder of microscopy images; matching labels are read from its masks subfolder.
scenes.speech_text: Make Masks is spacer's interactive editor for correcting segmentation labels and creating Cell Pose training pairs. Open a folder of microscopy images; matching labels are read from its masks subfolder.

scenes.narration: This isolated tutorial copy contains three real ER fields. The first two load ER-derived cell labels as colored overlays; the third deliberately has no existing mask.
scenes.speech_text: This isolated tutorial copy contains three real E R fields. The first two load E R derived cell labels as colored overlays; the third deliberately has no existing mask.

scenes.narration: The Tools card groups six edit modes. Brush adds foreground, Erase removes pixels, Erase object deletes one label, the two wands follow image intensity, and Zoom selects a detailed region.
scenes.speech_text: The Tools card groups six edit modes. Brush adds foreground, Erase removes pixels, Erase object deletes one label, the two wands follow image intensity, and Zoom selects a detailed region.

scenes.narration: Select Brush and set its radius in screen pixels. A click paints a spot and a gradual drag connects a boundary correction; the B key selects the same tool.
scenes.speech_text: Select Brush and set its radius in screen pixels. A click paints a spot and a gradual drag connects a boundary correction; the B key selects the same tool.

scenes.narration: Erase uses the same adjustable radius to remove only the painted part of a label. This is useful for separating a false bridge while preserving the rest of each cell.
scenes.speech_text: Erase uses the same adjustable radius to remove only the painted part of a label. This is useful for separating a false bridge while preserving the rest of each cell.

scenes.narration: Erase object removes the complete labeled object under one click. Use it for a definite false positive; Undo remains available if the selected object was valid.
scenes.speech_text: Erase object removes the complete labeled object under one click. Use it for a definite false positive; Undo remains available if the selected object was valid.

scenes.narration: Wand plus adds an intensity-connected region. Tolerance controls how far intensities may differ from the clicked ER pixel, while Max pixels prevents an accidental flood across the field.
scenes.speech_text: Wand plus adds an intensity connected region. Tolerance controls how far intensities may differ from the clicked E R pixel, while Max pixels prevents an accidental flood across the field.

scenes.narration: Wand minus follows the same intensity rule but subtracts the connected region. Adjust tolerance conservatively and inspect the result before moving to another image.
scenes.speech_text: Wand minus follows the same intensity rule but subtracts the connected region. Adjust tolerance conservatively and inspect the result before moving to another image.

scenes.narration: Zoom draws a rectangular region and expands it to the canvas, making cell boundaries easy to judge at 4K. Reset zoom, or press Escape, to return to the full field.
scenes.speech_text: Zoom draws a rectangular region and expands it to the canvas, making cell boundaries easy to judge at four K. Reset zoom, or press Escape, to return to the full field.

scenes.narration: Normalize changes only the displayed contrast. This ER field uses the second and ninety-ninth-point-five percentiles so dim boundaries remain visible without changing image data or label geometry.
scenes.speech_text: Normalize changes only the displayed contrast. This E R field uses the second and ninety ninth point five percentiles so dim boundaries remain visible without changing image data or label geometry.

scenes.narration: Undo and Redo step through mask edits independently of zoom and contrast. Their standard shortcuts are Control Z and Control Y, with Control Shift Z also available for redo.
scenes.speech_text: Undo and Redo step through mask edits independently of zoom and contrast. Their standard shortcuts are Control Z and Control Y, with Control Shift Z also available for redo.

scenes.narration: Object operations can fill internal holes, relabel connected foreground, invert foreground and background, or clear the mask. Clear asks for confirmation because it removes every current label.
scenes.speech_text: Object operations can fill internal holes, relabel connected foreground, invert foreground and background, or clear the mask. Clear asks for confirmation because it removes every current label.

scenes.narration: The minimum-area operation removes connected objects smaller than the selected pixel count. Here ten thousand makes the filtering effect obvious; choose a biologically appropriate threshold for production labels.
scenes.speech_text: The minimum area operation removes connected objects smaller than the selected pixel count. Here ten thousand makes the filtering effect obvious; choose a biologically appropriate threshold for production labels.

scenes.narration: Save mask relabels connected components and writes a uint16 TIFF to masks under the source image stem. This tutorial edits an isolated copy, leaving the original experiment unchanged.
scenes.speech_text: Save mask relabels connected components and writes an unsigned sixteen bit TIFF to masks under the source image stem. This tutorial edits an isolated copy, leaving the original experiment unchanged.

scenes.narration: Previous image and Next image move through the folder in filename order. The status line always shows the current file and position, so every training field can be reviewed systematically.
scenes.speech_text: Previous image and Next image move through the folder in filename order. The status line always shows the current file and position, so every training field can be reviewed systematically.

scenes.narration: An image without a companion mask opens with zero labels. Start with Brush or Wand plus, inspect and clean each object, then save the new pair for custom Cellpose training.
scenes.speech_text: An image without a companion mask opens with zero labels. Start with Brush or Wand plus, inspect and clean each object, then save the new pair for custom Cell Pose training.
